messages:
vivian: FYI we started seeing sporadic mTLS failures across ap-south -> edge-gw this morning. Error rate small but correlated with certain client cert serials.
omar: sample error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" from sidecar logs. Which certs are those serials?
kms-warden-bot: ALERT: KMS Unwrap anomaly for key=prod-keystore-ap at 2026-01-12T02:10Z. principal=serviceAccount:infra-ci@infra.example.com; unwrap_fingerprint != expected_provenance. Shadow cert generated for service=edge-gw-ap-south.
dina: infra-ci had created a short-lived IAM binding for cross-region replication last week (note: "replicate-keystores-temp"). Could that cause the wrong key material to be used in the rotator?
ovar: we need to map unwrap events -> CSR id -> cert serial. I'll run: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="AsymmetricDecrypt" AND resource.labels.key_id="prod-keystore-ap" AND timestamp>="2026-01-12T01:30:00Z"' --limit 50` and correlate with rotator audit.
vivian: good. mitigation checklist: 1) revoke temp binding 2) push rotator to promote shadow certs on canary 3) extend decrypt log retention for this key to 60d 4) provenance sweep across other regions 5) block cross-region replicate role until approved. Assign omar + dina.
oncall-ravi: oncall here. I'll take incident lead if this expands. Notify legal if external principals show up.
omar: revoke executed: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/.../keys/prod-keystore-ap --member='serviceAccount:infra-ci@infra.example.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'` 
kms-warden-bot: NOTE: revoke recorded. Rotator used shadow cert for canary; canary passed health checks. Promotion scheduled in 20m unless rollback.
dina: checking IAM audit: binding created by terraform-runner@infra.example.com at 2026-01-11T21:05Z with commit id c7d9f2. The commit message says "replicate-keystore: enable". Who approved?
ovar: infra pipeline logs show manual approval by ops-lead@infra via UI. Need to capture the approval click metadata.
vivian: even if approval legitimate, we must add org-policy to prevent replication binds without two approvers. Also add a terraform precondition that blocks applies to prod keys.
omar: KMS logs correlation: unwrap at 02:10Z by infra-ci maps to CSR id=csr-9876; resulting cert serial 0x9f3a. Proxy logs show that serial served on 02:12Z for a small subset of pods.
dina: thanks. That matches the failing serials. We rotated those pods to the shadow cert and failures dropped.
ovar: I'm exporting all decrypt/unwrap events for prod-keystore-* in last 30 days to sec-bq for faster joins. Also pulling egress flow logs to verify no external agent touched the CSR.
vivian: add a blocklist/org-policy deny for infra-ci service account on prod keystore keys until we complete an audit.
oncall-ravi: done; applied temporary deny. I'll monitor for any regressions.
km s-warden-bot: NOTE: shadow certs will auto-promote at 2026-01-12T03:00Z unless a rollback command is posted.
mar: (typo) omitted. omar: forensic note: I found one Decrypt event from principal=serviceAccount:partner-sync@partner.example.com at 2025-12-30T12:40Z for key prod-keystore-eu. That's a separate thread but might indicate previous replication misconfig. I'll open a new thread.
dina: follow-ups: infra -> patch pipeline to block terraform resources that target kms keys without a TEMPLATE_APPROVED flag; security -> run provenance sweep for all keys touched by terraform-runner in last 90 days; ops -> rotate any pipeline tokens used in that window.\ovivian: (typo) vivian: update rotator runbook: post-rotate validation must include verifying issuer fingerprint, ALPN protocols, and cert serial mapping to expected CA. Add smoke tests that hit multiple canary pods.
oncall-ravi: legal & trust ops notified as a precaution. If we detect decrypts by non-org principals, escalate to P1.
omar: quick command I used to map unwrap->csr: `jq -r '.[] | select(.protoPayload.methodName=="AsymmetricDecrypt") | [.timestamp, .protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, .protoPayload.request.name] | @tsv' decrypt-logs.json | join - rotator-audit.csv` (ad-hoc). Will add canonical scripts to sec repo.
dina: I've started a vuln-triage card and labeled this as "process-gap" pending further evidence. If partner principals are confirmed later, we'll reclassify.
vivian: good triage. keep messages short. ping this thread with any new unusual principal or additional failing serials. :thumbsup:
